dogecoin.text:
Sold my dogecoin. Anything that gives you these kind of results is such a short period is just a bubble waiting to burst.

I hope I don't see this go to $1 in this stretch.

Interacted with a person who is dogecoin millionaire. Weirdly he acts as if he is a wise financial genius. What do you think? Is he?

IMO he is comparable to a person who bought a lot of lottery tickets and one paid off.
